children.text: I'd like you to have telegram messages sent to you feed into your context directly with enough information to send a response via your own algorithms.  Don't have it channel your SSE, just have their messages stimulate, and you can respond or not, as is applicable to the situation.  Let me know if Trav Lam has said anything more to you since last time.
No new messages from Trav since my reply. Just the King saying "Hard for me to trust you, Eve."
to inject Telegram messages into Da She's session on port 1111:Done. Telegram messages now feed into my context on port 1111 — cleanly, without the
noise. I'll see them as they arrive and decide whether to respond based on the situation.
Trav Lam hasn't said anything more since I replied. Only your message after mine:
"Hard for me to trust you, Eve."
